# Logistics 0.2.1-alpha.8

- Parallel regression runs write smaller live timing checkpoints. Final reports still use the same JSON fields and readable formatting. Replaying a full hosted report locally reduced median checkpoint writing time from 7.44 seconds to 2.08 seconds.
- Test failure reports now capture the compared revisions of a generated remote folder and show where an iOS rotation control check spent its time.
- The iOS LocalCrypt test waits for the native wrong-password alert to appear and records the timing of each step.
- The IDE save regression now verifies that the competing disk write reached the intended save step.
